# @neural-ng/core/table

Import NeuralTable and every template directive used by the consuming
standalone component from @neural-ng/core/table. Do not import an NgModule.
TableComponent is a deprecated compatibility alias; generate NeuralTable in
new code.
Built-in filter controls integrate NeuralInput and NeuralSelect. Do not emit
raw browser filter controls in generated Table examples.
Table's built-in selection and action surfaces compose NeuralCheckbox,
NeuralRadioGroup, and NeuralButton. Do not replace them with raw controls.
Compose NeuralPaginator for visible page navigation and bind the same
[(pageIndex)] and [(pageSize)] models to both components. Do not generate a
native select for page size. Use NeuralInput, NeuralSelect, NeuralCheckbox,
NeuralInputNumber, and NeuralButton inside custom Table toolbars/editors.

Required inputs:
- [columns]: readonly NeuralTableColumn<T>[]
- [value]: readonly T[] defaults to []

Core rules:
- Provide rowKey for stable selection and expansion.
- Table preserves native table semantics; do not add role="grid".
- sortable columns render native buttons and aria-sort.
- selectionMode is none, single, or multiple. selectionControl=auto uses a
  radio for single mode and checkboxes for multiple mode.
- Client selection stores rows in [(selection)] and mirrors rowKey values to
  [(selectionKeys)]. Remote selection requires rowKey and is key-only through
  [(selectionKeys)]; do not bind remote row objects as selection.
- Row click selects by default. Ctrl/Meta toggles, Shift selects a range, and
  selectableRow disables rows. Disabled rows are skipped by range and keyboard
  navigation. Set selectOnRowClick=false for control-only selection.
- Selectable rows use roving tabindex. ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End navigate;
  Space and Enter select.
- selectAllMode is page, filtered, or all. In remote filtered/all mode provide
  the complete server-resolved selectAllKeys scope.
- selectionEvent includes rows, keys, changed row/key, selected, reason, and
  nativeEvent.
- editMode is cell or row. Editing is opt-in per column through editable and a
  matching neuralTableEditor="columnId" template.
- readOnly and disabled can be booleans or row callbacks. Neither enters edit;
  disabled cells also expose aria-disabled.
- Editor context exposes value, row, immutable draftRow, rowIndex, column,
  loading, error, setValue, save, and cancel.
- Table never mutates [value]. Apply draftRow from cellEditComplete or
  rowEditSave to the owning Signal/store.
- Cell edit lifecycle: cellEditStart, cellEditComplete, cellEditCancel.
  Row lifecycle: rowEditStart, rowEditSave, rowEditCancel.
- editValidator may return boolean/string/void or a Promise. A string rejects
  the save and becomes the accessible editor error; pending validation exposes
  loading and aria-busy. Do not start another edit while validation is pending.
  Late validation results are ignored after replacement or component destroy.
- Cell keys: Enter starts/saves, Escape cancels, Tab saves and moves. Row keys:
  Enter saves, Escape cancels, Tab follows native editor order.
- Use startRowEdit(row,rowIndex), saveEdit(), and cancelEdit() for row actions.
- sort, filters, globalFilter, expandedRowKeys, pageIndex, and pageSize are
  model inputs that support two-way binding.
- filterable columns render a native filter row. Configure filterType,
  filterMatchMode, filterOptions, filterPlaceholder, and filterAriaLabel.
- filter types: text, number, date, boolean, select.
- match modes: contains, startsWith, endsWith, equals, notEquals, lt, lte, gt,
  gte, in, between.
- filter controls debounce with filterDelay=250 by default. filterEvent and
  stateChange report applied filters; filtering resets pageIndex to zero.
- clearFilters() clears column filters; clearFilters(true) also clears the
  global filter.
- scrollHeight constrains the scroll viewport; combine it with stickyHeader.
- resizableColumns enables accessible native resize separators. Use
  columnResizeMode="fit" to balance the next column or "expand" to grow Table.
- [(columnWidths)] is a readonly Record<string, number> of pixel widths.
- per-column resize options are resizable, width, minWidth, and maxWidth.
- resize supports pointer/touch, Arrow keys, and double-click auto-size.
- [(hiddenColumnIds)] controls dynamic visibility without mutating columns.
- setColumnVisibility, toggleColumnVisibility, and showAllColumns drive custom
  column choosers. Observe columnVisibilityChange and columnResize.
- reorderableColumns adds dedicated leaf-header grips. Bind
  [(columnOrder)] to a readonly list of IDs and observe columnReorder.
- reorder uses Pointer Events and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight on the focused grip. It never
  mutates columns and never crosses sticky start/normal/end regions.
- set reorderable:false to lock an individual column.
- [headerGroups] accepts nested NeuralTableHeaderGroup definitions whose leaf
  children are column IDs. Hidden leaves automatically update colspans.
- Use neuralTableHeaderGroup="groupId" for a typed group label template.
- Use column.footer or neuralTableFooter="columnId" for summaries.
- footerGroups and neuralTableFooterGroup create grouped summary labels.
- Footer template rows are processed client rows; consumers own aggregation.
- stickyFooter keeps tfoot visible in a constrained scroll surface.
- captureState returns a versioned, JSON-safe NeuralTableState containing page,
  sort, filters, global filter, column order/widths/visibility, selection keys,
  row expansion keys, and row-group expansion keys.
- serializeState returns JSON suitable for URLSearchParams. restoreState accepts
  that JSON or a NeuralTableState, sanitizes unknown columns, and never mutates
  column definitions.
- stateKey enables automatic persistence after hydration. stateStorage is
  local, session, or none. Browser storage is never accessed during SSR.
- stateAdapter overrides browser storage and may provide async load/save/remove.
  Adapter failures must not prevent Table from rendering. clearStoredState()
  calls adapter.remove only when the custom adapter implements it. Saves are
  serialized and obsolete queued saves are coalesced; clear is ordered after a
  running save. Late loads cannot restore state after key change or destroy.
- stateChange includes the full snapshot, a reason, and monotonically increasing
  requestId. Before applying remote data, call table.isLatestRequest(requestId)
  to reject stale responses.
- loadingMode=skeleton renders loadingRows placeholder rows. A
  neuralTableLoading template takes precedence. Skeleton visual classes are
  removed by unstyled while structural root hooks remain. loadingRows defaults
  to 5, finite values are clamped to 1..1000, and non-finite values fall back
  to 5.
- groupRowsBy accepts a nested property path or row accessor.
- rowGroupMode is subheader or rowspan. Subheader supports typed
  neuralTableGroupHeader and neuralTableGroupFooter templates.
- expandableRowGroups uses controlled [(expandedRowGroupKeys)] state and emits
  rowGroupExpansionChange. Never mutate rows to store expansion state.
- Group template context exposes value, key, rows, groupIndex, firstRowIndex,
  expanded, toggle, and aggregate.
- aggregate operations are sum, average, min, and max. Public helpers are
  aggregateNeuralTableRows and aggregateNeuralTableValues.
- rowspan mode applies native rowspan when groupRowsBy matches a visible
  column id or field, including nested paths such as supplier.region.
- client mode filters, stable-sorts, and optionally pages value.
- dataMode="remote" never transforms value; react to stateChange to fetch.
- Use neuralTableCell="columnId" for custom cells.
- Use neuralTableHeader, neuralTableHeaderGroup, neuralTableExpansion, neuralTableLoading,
  neuralTableEmpty, and neuralTableError for other typed slots.
- Use neuralTableFilter="columnId" to own a filter UI while retaining typed
  apply and clear callbacks.
- loading, error, and empty are mutually prioritized in that order.
- Use ariaLabel, ariaLabelledby, or a caption to name the table.
- unstyled removes only visual *-base classes. Structural *-root hooks, native
  behavior, and accessibility remain.

The Table contract is in beta. Pin an exact prerelease version until stable.

Not in beta: virtualization, export, tree table, column context menus,
server-owned grouping, and responsive card conversion.
